author: /root/restart_geometric_model
claim: Actual target-neighborhood basis for explicitly finitely presented flat rank-one source modules

obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.binding: Finite algebra A→B; explicitly finitely presented flat B-module L with rankAtStalk L q=1 for every source prime q. The local-base helper uses genuine semilocality of the whole finite algebra.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.binding: The original L, B, original source/target section rings, and actual completed fifth map are retained. No surrogate invertible-module or dimension-only object.

obligations.name: Coverage
obligations.binding: For every target prime p, a is outside p. The localization is by algebraMap A B a, so it covers the whole source preimage, not a selected source prime.

obligations.name: Maps
obligations.binding: Actual sectionAlgebra is induced by map.app on each whole target chart. original_preimage is the actual Scheme basic-open preimage identity.

obligations.name: Localization
obligations.binding: Basis first constructed over B localized along the target prime complement, then descended by finite presentation to an original target element.

obligations.name: Identities
obligations.binding: A genuine Nonempty(Basis(Fin 1)...) witness, preserving the original localized module. No asserted canonical choice.

obligations.name: Consumer
obligations.binding: Actual chart point x gives a target basic open containing x with the same original module basis on its entire inverse image.

obligations.name: Evidence
obligations.binding: Three final strict source checks and target-only private-inclusive recursive audit 11/3. Immutable official direct source pins and accepted actual map predecessor are bound.

obligations.name: Boundary
obligations.binding: No automatic arbitrary-line-sheaf finite/flat/rank-one hypotheses, no restricted-sheaf frame yet, no cover-independent Picard/Jacobian/polarization/PEL conclusion.
